description: Weekly dependency updates: minor and patch grouped, majors on their own, no automerge.

packageRules.description: One PR for every minor, patch and digest update; majors get their own PRs.
ElegantFin gets its own PR, never automerged. The vendored CSS has to be regenerated with jellyfin-theme/vendor/update.sh and re-applied by hand.
prBodyNotes: Renovate cannot run the vendor script, so this PR only bumps the release and commit recorded in `jellyfin-theme/vendor/VERSIONS`. The vendored CSS is still the old release. Before merging, check out this branch, run `jellyfin-theme/vendor/update.sh <commit>` with the new full commit sha (it rewrites the vendored files, VERSIONS and dist/theme.css), commit the result, then re-apply the theme on Jellyfin.

customManagers.description: Watch the vendored ElegantFin release in jellyfin-theme/vendor/VERSIONS. Renovate cannot run jellyfin-theme/vendor/update.sh, so its PR only bumps the recorded release and commit. The CSS must be regenerated with that script and re-applied by hand.
